mentions.name: MPC Live III fluency project
mentions.description: A personal learning project to master the MPC Live III music production instrument: learning all of its features and developing several workflows to the point of fluency, so songs can be created without constantly pausing to figure out how to do something.
mentions.problem: Song creation is disrupted by constantly having to figure out how to do things on the instrument.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have decided to put my GAS behind me and focus on truly learning one musical instrument, the MPC Live III. I aim to learn all the features and come up with several workflows at which I become fluent. The goal is to enable me to create songs without having to worry about constantly figuring out how to do something.
